name: My Axe Is Notched
game_text:
Plays to your support area.
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, place a <culture>Dwarven</culture> token on this card.
While you can spot X <culture>Dwarven</culture> tokens on this card and the same number of <culture>Elven</culture> tokens on Final Count, Gimli is strength +X (limit +3).
